width_in.note: Polestar gives only '(I) Car width, mirrors folded: 81.4 in' and '(J) Car width, mirrors extended: 84.2 in'; no body width without mirrors. Not comparable with other models' mirrorless widths. C/D's 'without mirrors' figure (81.4) matches the mirrors-folded number.

awd.note: 'Drivetrain': Rear motor 'Rear-wheel drive'; Dual motor 'All-wheel drive'.
